name: facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tutorials/nb_python/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.simulate_physics: simulate the habitat-sim physics world for a specified duration and return sensor observations
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.camera_track_objects: simulate the scene while having the camera track the center of mass of objects
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.project_3d_to_2d: project a 3D point into 2D image space for a particular visual sensor
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.modify_object_template: modify an object template properties like scale mass and friction then register it
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.customize_primitive_asset: customize primitive asset templates like capsule cone or cylinder geometric properties

facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.make_cfg: build a habitat-sim simulator configuration with color, depth, and semantic camera sensor specs from a settings dictionary
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.make_simulator_from_settings: create a habitat-sim simulator instance with physics enabled and load object template configs from settings
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.simulate: run the habitat-sim physics simulation for a given number of world seconds at 60Hz and collect observations
